name: G R Infraprojects Ltd
title: G R Infraprojects Ltd - 543317 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 standalone revenue up 27% to INR2,521 cr but adjusted EBITDA margin fell to ~11% from 15.5%, with execution slowed by land delays and fuel-linked cost spikes; FY27 guidance is 15% growth and INR20,000-22,000 cr order wins.

capex.quote: it will be INR300 crores to INR350 crores

triggers.label: Margin hit by fuel and bitumen costs
triggers.quote: if this disturbance continues, then nothing can be said about the margin

triggers.label: Execution rate held flat, land delays
triggers.quote: Execution rate we have to assume at same level.

triggers.label: Receivables days up to 128 from 117
triggers.quote: Working capital in days at the end of March 2026 is 128 days as compared to 117 days

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth guided ~15%
triggers.quote: expect to grow our top lines in the range of 15%

guidance.quote: expect to grow our top lines in the range of 15%
target of new wins by INR20,000 crores to INR22,000 crores approximately
it will be INR300 crores to INR350 crores
we estimate a contribution of INR1,000 crores
our target for this sector is around INR1,000, INR1,200 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: You had guided for about INR3,000 crores of revenue in Q4

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue guidance missed; execution slowing
red_flags.quote: Due to the appointed date not coming in one particular project, there was a bit of an effect

red_flags.label: Receivables and working capital stretched
red_flags.quote: the increase is primarily on account of the debtors' days

red_flags.label: Income tax search disclosed
red_flags.quote: search is generally for last six plus current year period

evasions.topic: Land availability for HAM appointed dates
evasions.quote: That is not so handy right now.
no one is able to predict yet
